before:
`flask.sessions.SessionInterface.get_cookie_domain` uses
`SESSION_COOKIE_DOMAIN` when it is configured and otherwise falls back to
detecting the domain from `SERVER_NAME`.
after:
`flask.sessions.SessionInterface.get_cookie_domain` uses
`SESSION_COOKIE_DOMAIN` when it is configured and otherwise returns `None`.
It no longer falls back to detecting the domain from `SERVER_NAME`.
